decisions:
Title rows: 'Title [U.C.00xx]

<Name> Story - STAGE n' (en_short names); faction stages: 'STAGE n - Faction -'. Leading full-width padding dropped.
Faction labels use title case ('Zeon Forces', 'Crossbone Forces') to match 'Federation Forces'; glossary lowercases 'forces' for running text.
rec1 = engage line, rec2 = victory condition (imperative), rec3 = defeat condition (descriptive: 'Your unit destroyed, or ...').
uncertain: S00327: glossary 'Operation Earth Cooling' is marked unverified; used as given.
S00302/S00314/S00318/S00322/S00325: read rec3 as defeat conditions (S00322 Nahel Argama on the AEUG side supports this).
S00340: ibushi-gin no gyakushuu - 'The Veterans Strike Back'; idiomatic, no official English.
S00267/S00269/S00271/S00346: episode-style titles translated literally; may have official ZZ episode English titles worth checking.
